title: Shower Door Hardware 8-Inch Single-Side Shower Door Pull Solid Brass Clearview Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade your shower door hardware with this 8-Inch single-side shower door pull. Crafted from solid brass and accented with clear acrylic, it brings clean lines that work well in a transitional bathroom hardware plan and coordinate with versatile bath accessories in the Clearview collection.

Highlights:
- Use as a shower door handle / shower door pull for glass shower doors
- Solid brass construction with clear acrylic accents
- Concealed screw mounting for a streamlined appearance
- Easy installation; mounting hardware included
- Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes

Specs:
- Collection: Clearview collection
- Style: Contemporary
- Mounting type: Shower door mount
- Dimensions: 9 in L x 1.7 in W x 3.9 in H
- Weight: 3.2 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included: Shower door pull and all installation hardware
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Clearview Collection 8 Inch Single Side Shower Door Pull
_previous.description: The clean sharp lines of this modern shower door pull fits well with any bathroom décor ranging from modern to traditional. Made from high quality solid brass with accents of clear acrylic and provided with your choice of any of our lifetime designer finishes, the shower door pull is extremely attractive yet highly functional. Ideal for glass shower doors of all sizes and styles, the easy to install shower door pull comes with durable u-shaped pull made from solid brass and all the hardware necessary for installation.
